subject: science
explanation: Pressure is the force acting per unit area. The same force can produce very different effects depending on how spread out the contact is. A sharp knife cuts because all the force is squeezed into a tiny edge -- the pressure is huge. A heavy elephant walking does not sink into soft mud as much as a thin high-heel on the same mud, because the elephant's weight is spread across a large foot. The formula is pressure = force / area. In SI units, force is measured in newtons (N), area in square metres (m^2), and pressure in pascals (Pa).
examples: A drawing pin has a flat head (lots of area for your thumb) and a sharp point (tiny area for the wall) -- you press gently but the wall feels enormous pressure.
School bags have wide, padded straps so the same weight is spread over more shoulder area -- lower pressure, less pain.
Snow shoes are very wide so a person's weight doesn't push deep into soft snow.

brainstorming.question: Why does a sharp knife cut more easily than a blunt one?
brainstorming.answer: Both knives can use the same downward force, but the sharp knife's edge has a much smaller area. Pressure = force / area, so a smaller area means a larger pressure -- enough to push the metal through the food.

brainstorming.question: If you stand on one foot, does the pressure under your shoe change?
brainstorming.answer: Yes. Your weight is the same, but now the area in contact is just one shoe instead of two. The pressure under that single shoe roughly doubles.

brainstorming.question: Why are dam walls thicker at the bottom than at the top?
brainstorming.answer: Water pressure grows with depth, so the wall at the bottom has to push back against much greater pressure than the wall near the surface. A thicker wall can resist that force without cracking.

quiz.question: Pressure is defined as:
quiz.explanation: Pressure is force per unit area, i.e. force divided by area.

quiz.question: If the same force is applied through a smaller area, the pressure becomes:
quiz.explanation: Smaller area in the denominator means larger pressure for the same force.

quiz.question: The SI unit of pressure is the:
quiz.explanation: One pascal equals one newton per square metre.

quiz.question: Why do school bags have wide, padded straps?
options: They reduce pressure on the shoulder by increasing the contact area
quiz.explanation: Wider straps spread the same weight over more area, lowering the pressure on the shoulder.
